description: Initial absence-of-evidence baseline; never infer acceptance from workflows.yaml or CI.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Clean throwaway HOME; packaged Desktop (electron-builder --dir, Electron 44.11) first launch; Continue on Welcome desk; Create harness via onboarding confirmation; Enter the world; Workspace > Link existing folder; confirm Review project link for the fixture repo.
runs.observed: Real onboarding completed with no CLI init, no localStorage seeding and no manual config; workspace created by the UI; fixture-repo linked (LINKED badge, Open in World, symlink projects/fixture-repo). Only substitution: the OS-native folder picker is stubbed in the main process to return the fixture path (headless Electron cannot drive native dialogs). This run also exposed and required the server fix in #1773: project add rejected repos outside workspace roots with 403. Backend binary built from the server-fix commit; packaged exe from main b7cf08ee.

Prerequisite: OpenCode Go subscription, a provider API key configured in OpenCode, or free-quota reset.

Orphan process cleaned up after capture.

limitations: Gate 0 remains unverified overall: D01 (true first-run onboarding) was pre-seeded in this trial and is still unverified; D02-D07 are proven only for claude on linux-x86_64. Codex/OpenCode traversals, the failure-condition matrix, 1024x640/1440x900/1920x1080 + keyboard/reduced-motion audit, and macOS/Windows installers remain outstanding.

Packaged binary required Electron ^44.11.0: the previously pinned 44.4.5 segfaults on kernel 7.2 (see PR fixing the pin). Trial ran under ozone headless (no physical display) with system GL swiftshader.
The interactive session path streams raw PTY bytes only; structured tool-call events exist only in headless provider modes (see ADR-043 spike measurements).
Provider credential hygiene: the trial rotated the operator OAuth token; the maintainer must re-run `claude /login` for their own CLI after such trials.
